(15) \mu=\mu_{max}\left[1-\frac{X}{X_{m}}\right]      <- "tic growth based on biomass concentration only. The model accounts for inhibition of substrate (Ali et al., 2017). The Logistic model is defined by equation 15."

(17) \mu=\frac{\mu_{max}S\left(1+\frac{s}{K_{i}}\right)}{S+K_{s}+\left(\frac{s^{2}}{K_{i}}\right)}      <- "e Haldane and the Webb model. The Haldane model does not have the term $ (1 + \frac{S}{K_i}) $. The Webb model is defined by Eq. (17) (Dey and Mukherjee, 2010)."
